# blendops-final-check

Purpose: Check scene readiness, collect render and export evidence, write preview and runtime-attempt reports, and verify before handoff.

Metadata: Contract `v2.0.0` | Category `evidence-and-handoff` | Role `scene-readiness-evidence-preview-and-attempt-report` | Tier `L0` | Runtime default `Not Run` | Artifact default `Not Produced` | Mutation `downgrade_only`

## When to use & trigger cues
- A scene must be checked before render or export.
- Render or export evidence must be collected.
- A preview report or runtime-attempt report is needed.
- Work is about to be handed off.
- Trigger phrases: "looks ready, can we ship?", "I think the render is good — verify before sending", "before saving the evidence file...", "is this Verified or do we downgrade?", "confirm whether this claim holds or must be downgraded", "quality-check this scene", "is this ready", "evaluate pass warn fail", "Did the render produce?", "Can I claim the GLB exists?", "Verify export evidence.", "What artifact status should this have?", "Summarize preview/render/GLB evidence.", "summarize the render", "write up the export evidence", "what's the preview status", "write up what we tried", "runtime attempt log", "postmortem blender connect", "evidence report template"

## When not to use (delegation boundaries)
- the user explicitly asked for a draft, not a verified deliverable → use `blendops-fix-problems` (`references/skill-blendops-fix-problems.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-fix-problems)
- as a replacement for evidence collection → use `blendops-product-shot` (`references/skill-blendops-product-shot.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-product-shot)
- to fabricate confidence in missing artifacts → use `blendops-lighting-materials` (`references/skill-blendops-lighting-materials.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-lighting-materials)
- the user only needs a scene plan with no runtime or artifact evidence → use `blendops-connect-blender` (`references/skill-blendops-connect-blender.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-connect-blender)
- runtime readiness or path selection has not been completed and the user wants setup or routing; use blendops-connect-blender or blendops-connect-blender → use `blendops-connect-blender` (`references/skill-blendops-connect-blender.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-connect-blender)
- the task is GLB web integration after evidence is already classified and gated; use blendops-glb-web-handoff → use `blendops-glb-web-handoff` (`references/skill-blendops-glb-web-handoff.md`; Delegates out-of-scope requests to blendops-glb-web-handoff)
- raw debug logs or crash triage → use `blendops-fix-problems` (`references/skill-blendops-fix-problems.md`; use blendops-fix-problems instead)
- Diagnosing systematic runtime or scene defects (blendops-fix-problems) → use `blendops-fix-problems` (`references/skill-blendops-fix-problems.md`; blendops-fix-problems)
- Running pre-attempt environment checks (blendops-connect-blender) → use `blendops-connect-blender` (`references/skill-blendops-connect-blender.md`; blendops-connect-blender)
- Selecting which runtime path to use before an attempt (blendops-connect-blender) → use `blendops-connect-blender` (`references/skill-blendops-connect-blender.md`; blendops-connect-blender)

## Input & output contract
- Required input `candidate_delivery_package` (`object`): Complete set of planning, quality validation, runtime attempt, and artifact evidence records
- Required input `proposed_truth_state_claims` (`object`): Proposed Runtime status and Artifact status labels to audit against the 7-point release gate
- Optional input `active_blocker_or_failed_gate_notes` (`array`): Any upstream Warn/Fail quality verdicts or unresolved runtime blockers
- Optional input `scene_plan_and_specialist_verdicts` (`object`): Scene specification plus specialist rows from material, lighting, composition, and polycount checkers
- Optional input `acceptance_criteria_table` (`object`): Measurable Pass/Warn/Fail thresholds for the target deliverable
- Optional input `preview_or_inspection_notes` (`object`): Optional read-only scene inspection summary or viewport preview notes
- Optional input `candidate_artifact_records` (`array`): Reported file paths, byte sizes, SHA-256 digests, and inspection outputs for renders or GLBs
- Optional input `runtime_execution_trace` (`object`): Factual runtime attempt record indicating whether Blender actually ran
- Optional input `glb_inspector_or_validator_report` (`object`): Optional output from scripts/inspect-glb.mjs or Khronos gltf-validator
- Optional input `classified_artifact_evidence` (`object`): Verified or Produced artifact evidence record from blendops-final-check
- Optional input `quality_checker_summary` (`object`): Pass/Warn/Fail summary from blendops-final-check and specialist validators
- Optional input `known_visual_caveats` (`array`): Optional non-blocking visual warnings or pending stakeholder review questions
- Optional input `attempted_runtime_path_and_host` (`object`): Path 1, Path 2, or CLI appendix route and MCP host configuration used during the attempt
- Optional input `chronological_execution_log` (`array`): Timestamped sequence of read-only or mutation tool calls, responses, and observed outcomes
- Optional input `version_stamps` (`object`): Exact Blender version, add-on version, and MCP client version strings
- Optional input `pre_mutation_backup_record` (`object`): Optional .blend checkpoint backup metadata if an L1+ mutation was attempted
- Output contract: `seven_point_release_gate_table`, `enforced_downgrade_only_truth_states`, `release_clearance_or_remediation_route`, `holistic_scene_quality_verdict`, `aggregated_pass_warn_fail_table`, `blocking_defect_remediation_route`, `artifact_truth_state_ledger`, `downgrade_only_evidence_classification`, `missing_evidence_remediation_checklist`, `stakeholder_preview_evidence_packet`, `truth_state_and_provenance_summary`, `pre_handoff_gate_submission`, `structured_runtime_attempt_report_md`, `locked_runtime_and_artifact_truth_labels`, `eval_evidence_archival_path` (Runtime status: `Not Run`, Artifact status: `Not Produced`, `downgrade_only`).

## Quick-start steps
1. Confirm the user's goal and the current runtime and artifact state.
2. Pick the branch in the decision tree below.
3. Load only that branch's reference file and follow it.
4. Reply with the user-facing template, keeping truth states honest.

## Cross-skill handoffs
- [boundary_delegation] Entry wiring (blendops-start) → `blendops-start` (`references/skill-blendops-start.md`) — `when.all: [request.scope equals "general_help"]`
- [upstream_reference] Entry wiring (blendops-start) → `blendops-start` (`references/skill-blendops-start.md`) — `when.all: [preflight.passed equals true; inventory.exists equals true]`
- [conditional] If verdict is Pass (blendops-start) → `blendops-start` (`references/skill-blendops-start.md`) — `when.all: [stage.current equals "final_communication"]`
- [upstream_reference] scene/asset quality gap (blendops-camera) → `blendops-camera` (`references/skill-blendops-camera.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "composition"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- [upstream_reference] scene/asset quality gap (blendops-lighting-materials) → `blendops-lighting-materials` (`references/skill-blendops-lighting-materials.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "lighting"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- [upstream_reference] scene/asset quality gap (blendops-lighting-materials) → `blendops-lighting-materials` (`references/skill-blendops-lighting-materials.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "material"; quality.verdict equals "not_run"]`
- [upstream_reference] scene/asset quality gap (blendops-glb-budget) → `blendops-glb-budget` (`references/skill-blendops-glb-budget.md`) — `when.all: [quality.domain equals "polycount"; budget.verdict equals "Not Run"]`
- [fallback] runtime/bridge failure (blendops-fix-problems) → `blendops-fix-problems` (`references/skill-blendops-fix-problems.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.errorDetected equals true]`
- [fallback] runtime/bridge failure (blendops-connect-blender) → `blendops-connect-blender` (`references/skill-blendops-connect-blender.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path not_equals "unselected"; runtime.verifiedReady equals false]`
- [fallback] runtime/bridge failure (blendops-connect-blender) → `blendops-connect-blender` (`references/skill-blendops-connect-blender.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.conflictDetected equals true]`
- [conditional] Web delivery (when applicable) → `blendops-glb-web-handoff` (`references/skill-blendops-glb-web-handoff.md`) — `when.all: [artifact.type equals "glb"; handoff.consumerStack equals "web_glb"]`
- [upstream_reference] Runtime path selection context → `blendops-connect-blender` (`references/skill-blendops-connect-blender.md`) — `when.all: [runtime.path equals "unselected"]`

## Safety boundaries & non-goals
- Runtime boundary: BlendOps runtime guidance uses **2 MCP execution paths plus a CLI fallback appendix** (replaces older 3-stack and 4-route drafts — see `docs/runtime-stack-strategy.md` for the corrected attribution history):
- Does not install Blender, configure an MCP bridge, or own a runtime; it points to upstream paths only.
- Does not claim render, export, preview, or GLB results without evidence.
- Does not hand the user Python as the final interface.
